cards.text: Jesus has just told His disciples that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Him: 'And He was numbered with the transgressors.' (Luke 22:37). Now He goes out, as usual, to the Mount of Olives. The disciples follow Him.

cards.question: When they reach the place on the Mount of Olives, Jesus tells the disciples what to pray for. What is it?

answers.text: That they will not enter into temptation
That the crowds will not find them here
That the city will receive their message

cards.text: Then Jesus goes on about a stone's throw beyond them, kneels down and prays, "Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me." Friend, that's the Son of God on His knees, talking to His Father.

cards.question: After asking the Father to take this cup from Him, Jesus prays for His own will to be done.
While Jesus is praying on the Mount of Olives, someone appears from heaven and strengthens Him. Who is it?

cards.text: Jesus is in anguish now, and in that anguish, He prays even more earnestly. Lean in close, friend, because this moment is heavy.

cards.question: As Jesus prays in His anguish, His sweat becomes like drops of blood falling to the ground.

cards.text: Jesus rises from prayer and goes back to the disciples. Remember, before He stepped away, He told them to pray.

cards.question: When Jesus comes back from praying, what does He find the disciples doing?
When Jesus finds the disciples asleep, they are exhausted from ___.

cards.text: "Why are you sleeping?" Jesus asks. Friend, I've been caught dozing on oven duty, and there is NO good answer to that question.
Then that line again: "Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation."
While Jesus is still speaking, a crowd arrives, led by the man called Judas. Friend, Judas is one of the Twelve, one of Jesus's OWN.

cards.question: Judas walks right up to Jesus in front of the crowd. What is he coming to do?

cards.text: But Jesus asks him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?" The Son of Man is the name Jesus uses for Himself (Mark 2:10).

cards.question: Judas has led a crowd to Jesus, and the men around Jesus see what's about to happen. What do they ask Him?

answers.text: Should we strike with our swords
Should we run back to the city
Should we call down fire on them

cards.question: Before Jesus answers, one of the men around Him swings his sword. Who does he hit?

answers.text: The servant of the high priest

cards.text: The sword cuts off the servant's right ear.
Then Jesus answers: "No more of this!" Asking first and acting before the answer comes is like asking your passenger, "Should I merge here?" and merging before they can say a word.

cards.question: Jesus touches the ear of the high priest's servant and heals him.

cards.text: Then Jesus speaks to the chief priests, temple officers and elders who came for Him. They brought swords and clubs for the Man who just healed the high priest's servant.

cards.question: Jesus asks the chief priests, temple officers and elders if they've come out with swords and clubs the way they would against someone. Who?
Jesus tells the chief priests and elders that every day He was with them in the temple courts, they laid hands on Him.
Jesus tells the chief priests, temple officers and elders that this hour belongs to them and to the power of ___.

cards.text: And that's where we'll set this batch down for now. Keep the oven warm, friend, because this story is far from over.
